description.value: The BIS/BAS questionnaires measured behavioral inhibition and behavioral activation, including reward responsiveness, drive, and fun-seeking.

spans.text: The BIS Scale (seven items), measuring behaviors consistent with a withdrawal motivation, contains items describing the degree to which people characteristically express anxiety when confronted with cues for punishment. The BAS Scale (13 items) targets behaviors consistent with an approach motivation, and is divided into subscales representing reward responsiveness (BAS-RR: five items), drive toward appetitive goals (BAS-D: four items), and fun-seeking (BAS-FS: four items).
